title: canthium oligocarpum subsp. friesiorum
intro: Canthium oligocarpum subsp. friesiorum, commonly known as the 'Yellow Bells', is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to aid in reducing fever and inflammation, and exhibit analgesic and anti-diarrheal properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Canthium oligocarpum subsp. friesiorum have been found to possess potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which can aid in protecting against oxidative stress and microbial infections.
